fixture_objective.title: Recover Q3 monthly active revenue to pre-Q1 baseline
fixture_objective.description: Recover MoM index after the −5.5% Q3 contraction.

assessment.progress_rationale: Per tracking doc 2, revenue index reached 98 against target of 100 by Day 150 (approx. DATE_3), with Phase 3 stabilisation underway and trajectory on track to meet target, indicating strong but not yet complete progress.
assessment.probability_rationale: Corpus-tier claim with supporting BASE and TRACKING evidence, but future trajectory projection introduces moderate uncertainty.

explanation.headline: Revenue index recovered to 98 by Day 150 through successful checkout fixes, reactivation campaigns exceeding targets, and sustained session stabilisation across all three planned phases.

causes.observation: Phase 1 checkout fix and session recovery lifted weekly active sessions to 95 baseline, establishing the foundation for revenue recovery.
Phase 2 reactivation campaign delivered 14% response rate, exceeding the 12% target, and pushed revenue index to 94.
causes.evidence_citation: Recovery — ops update (TRACKING): 'Reactivation response 14% (target 12%). Revenue index 94.'

causes.observation: Phase 3 stabilisation efforts brought revenue index to 98 with sessions holding at 99 baseline, maintaining trajectory toward the 100 target.
causes.evidence_citation: Recovery — ops update (TRACKING): 'Revenue index 98 this period. Sessions stable at 99 baseline.'

explanation.summary_prose: The recovery progressed systematically through three phases: initial checkout repair and session recovery, followed by an over-performing reactivation campaign, and culminating in stabilisation that brought the revenue index to 98. Each phase met or exceeded its milestone, with tracking documents confirming sustained session levels and revenue trajectory aligned to reach the target index of 100 by Day 150.
